correctness.rationale: Two independent full face-generation methods give 780 faces, 779 nonempty with f-vector (20,130,320,265,44). Exact 382-pair face-poset matching leaves one cell in dimension 0, one in dimension 2, thirteen in dimension 3; topological sorting all 2500 oriented Hasse incidences verifies acyclicity. Signed rational boundaries computed exactly give ranks (19,111,208,44), hence reduced H3(Q) has dimension 13. The integral 13-to-1 Morse differential is therefore zero because its rational rank is zero. All 3-cell attachments to S2 have degree zero and are null-homotopic, proving an integral wedge S2∨13S3. This only asserts a complete result for a finite object.

value.rationale: The five-by-five chessboard complex is the first classical square matching complex whose second integral homology is proven to be nontrivial three-torsion (Jonsson Theorem 3.1). Removing the unique natural full diagonal (one forbidden perfect matching) yields a connected symmetric crown graph; the resulting ordinary matching complex unexpectedly loses all torsion and acquires an integral two-sphere together with thirteen three-spheres. The precise size-five computation describes a meaningful sharp torsion-sensitive perturbation of a canonical example rather than an arbitrary slice or re-enumeration of derangements.
